headline: Attijariwafa Bank Nine-Month Profit Rises 10% on Strong Loan Growth
summary: Attijariwafa bank reported a 10.3% increase in group profit to $909 million for the first nine months, driven by 12.6% loan growth and a sharp decline in loan-loss charges.
why: Earnings reports from major commercial banks reflect domestic credit demand and asset quality trends within regional banking sectors.
